- “Lost”, and  
- “Yes, send replacement” (or “No replacement yet”).  
Then I’ll immediately block that card and request a new one.</action>

I tried to block your Personal Card ending in 1111 and request a replacement, but our card-reporting system returned an internal error and didn’t complete the request. Because this involves a lost card, you shouldn’t wait for it to start working again.

1) Call customer support (fastest for card emergencies)  
   - Use the number on the back of any of your other cards or the “Contact Us” number on our website or mobile app.  
   - When connected, say something like:  
     “I need to report my Personal credit card ending in 1111 as lost and get a replacement. I already confirmed it’s not stolen, just lost.”  

2) Use the mobile app or online banking (if available with your bank)  
   - Go to: Cards (or “Manage Cards”) → Select “Personal Card ****1111” → “Report lost card” or “Lock/replace card.”

   - Bring an ID; tell them you need to report your Personal credit card ending in 1111 as lost and request a replacement.

- That it’s your Personal Card ending in 1111  
- Issue type: Lost, not stolen  
- That you want a replacement mailed to your address on file

If you tell me how you prefer to contact them (phone, app, or in person), I can outline the exact steps or a short script you can read to the agent so it’s as quick as possible.</action>
